scope.included: Annual Seoul, Busan-Gyeongnam, Yeongcheon race score SQLite and running_trials score SQLite catalog candidates.
excluded: Jeju data rows (meet=2), including rows embedded in combined running_trials score files

candidate_selection.historical_provenance_and_completeness: Not established by this structural profile.

reference_sources.coverage_note: Comparisons use meet/date/race number and participant slot (horse_number or source analogue), with dates at/before target cutoff. No source is ranked as authoritative.
reference_sources.trial_historical_slot_caveat: historical_unified.trial_entry.participant_no is compared descriptively to candidate horse_number; equivalence is not assumed. Official horse-ID keys are also compared where present.
reference_sources.operational_backup_note: Separate root-maintained backup comparison reports 16 race and 180 entry keys in two older SQLite backups beyond the current operation DB. Those keys remain unadjudicated and are not treated here as confirmed source facts.
